title: Xdrip + (Delay by reading raw values)
symptom: There is a delay by reading raw values in Xdrip+, caused by the patched Libre 2 app or sensor. This delay is summarized and if the delay is longer than 3 minutes, Xdrip+ leaves a gap on the graph. This happens every 4 hours.
cause: The gap is caused by a relative time drift between the phone's time base and the transmitter's local time base, which is never synchronized. When the drift crosses a minute boundary, a gap or compression appears on the graph because the graph time resolution is 1 minute.
fix: No fix is provided; the issue is considered expected behavior and closed as a non-issue. The maintainer states there is no way to avoid the gaps or compressions.
evidence_quote: There is no way to avoid the gaps, or compressions. We can move them around in the graph. But, there is no way to avoid them.
